questions.q: What does the capstone's Azure side need to provision, according to the brief?
options: Only an EKS cluster
A resource group, a virtual network, and an App Service running the storefront API
Only an S3 bucket
A Lambda function
questions.explain: The Azure side of the capstone brief covers a resource group, virtual network, and an App Service for the storefront API.

questions.q: What does the capstone's AWS side need to provision?
options: A virtual network and App Service
A VPC, an S3 bucket for product images, and a Lambda function for order-confirmation emails
An Azure Key Vault
Only an EC2 instance with no networking
questions.explain: The AWS side covers a VPC, an S3 bucket for product images, and a Lambda function handling order-confirmation emails.

questions.q: What folder structure pattern does the capstone follow for environments?
options: Terraform workspaces exclusively
Directory-per-environment, with shared modules called from an environments/dev folder
A single flat folder with no modules
One Terraform Cloud organization per resource
questions.explain: The capstone mirrors Chapter 7's directory-per-environment pattern: shared modules called from an environments/dev (and eventually staging/prod) folder, each with its own backend and tfvars.

questions.q: Which of these is listed as part of the capstone's acceptance criteria?
options: Using only the default Terraform workspace
Every resource carries at least an 'environment' and 'project' tag, and no secret appears in any committed file
All resources must be created manually first, then imported
State must be stored locally for faster access
questions.explain: The acceptance criteria require consistent tagging, no committed secrets, and remote (not local) state, among other checks.

questions.q: What will Lesson 35 cover, according to this kickoff lesson?
options: Installing Terraform for the first time
Writing the actual root configuration and modules, including a real terraform plan output
Choosing between Terraform and Bicep
Deleting the capstone environment permanently
questions.explain: Lesson 35 ('Capstone: Build It') walks through writing the real root main.tf/variables.tf/outputs.tf and module calls, with an actual terraform plan output.
